gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.tip: Call %s over to you, wherever it is: in another dimension, in its Guh House or the Guh Room, as a picked-up guh in a chest, in a Guh Wheel, on holiday... You first see what will happen.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.later: %1$s is in the pockets of %2$s, who is not online now. As soon as %2$s logs in, %1$s comes to you!
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.wereld: %s is walking around somewhere. It drops everything and comes to you.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.zit: %s is sitting somewhere (you told it to sit). It gets up and comes to you.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.huisje: Note: %s lives in its Guh House now. If you call it, it moves out of the house: its spot and its chores there are gone.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.slaapt_in_h: Note: %s is asleep in its Guh House. It wakes up and moves out of the house: its spot and its chores there are gone.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.rijdt_op: %1$s is being ridden. The rider gets off and %1$s comes to you.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.rijdt_mee: %s is riding along on something. It gets off and comes to you.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.item_speler: Note: %s is a picked-up guh in a player's pockets. It leaves those pockets and comes to you. If that player is not online, it comes as soon as they log in.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.item_kist: Note: %s is a picked-up guh in a chest now. It leaves the chest and comes to you.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.item_rugzak: Note: %s is a picked-up guh in another guh's backpack. It leaves the backpack and comes to you.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.item_bank: Note: %s is a picked-up guh in a Bank Guh. It leaves the Bank Guh and comes to you.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.item_grond: %s is lying on the ground as a picked-up guh. It jumps up and comes to you.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.guhwiel: Note: %s is running in a Guh Wheel now. If you call it over, the wheel stops and makes no more vadskracht.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.guhkamer: %s is staying in the Guh Room. It checks out and comes to you.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.schouder: %s is sitting on someone's shoulder. It jumps off and comes to you.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.in_guh: %s is inside another guh. It comes out and comes to you.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.onbekend: We don't know exactly where %s is. We'll look for it; if we can't find it, you'll hear.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.in_de_wolkj: %s is in the little clouds. Calling won't help, but the Cuddle Heart will.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.bij_jou: %s was already with you. It comes a little closer.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.op_vakantie: Note: %s is on holiday (Travel Agency). If you call it now, it cuts its trip short: no postcard and no souvenir.
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.vraag.op_kantoor: Note: %s is at work in the office. It clocks out right away; you still get the pay for the shifts it already finished.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.bezig.opgepakt: Picked up and kept somewhere (see below). It is taken out first.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.scherm.sub: Njeg, not gone for good, just retired! Pick guhs and other vadsjes and send them off or bring them back.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.scherm.vraag.teks: These vadsjes are busy with something: %s
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.scherm.vraag.uitl: They stop and retire (out of their house, off the Guh Wheel, out of the chest they are kept in...).
gui.guhs.mijnguhs.roep.verloren: %s lay on the ground as a parcel, but the parcel is gone (burned or lost). Njeg... It is in the clouds now: bring it back with the Cuddle Heart!
